content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to access the transistor output schema for the digital output in [product_name] with [version_no]? I would like to know if it uses an open collector transistor and how to manage it, since the official user manual lacks this detail. Best regards [user_name]
I hope the attached file is useful.

Thank you [user_name], I am specifically looking for a circuit diagram of the output, showing whether Q and M on the digital output are linked to the emitter or collector of the transistor, and indicating the 24V and GND connections.
The connection diagram is in the attachment.

From your message, I see that you are interested in the internal wiring of the [product_name] outputs and how the transistors are configured. There isn't a public drawing revealing how the transistors are arranged, and it's unlikely that a typical user can specify the exact transistor type used. I can confirm that the 'M' terminals paired with outputs are actually common across all outputs. Connecting any one output's 'M' will set the reference for all outputs. Your reasons for asking might be: (a) Replicating the concept for protecting TTL outputs on a custom board. (b) Attempting to fix a faulty output. (c) Using a device that requires an NPN connection. If you share why you're asking, someone might offer more targeted assistance. Regards, [user_name]
